scope.interactionChannel: real macOS character and Return input via cliclick

observations.name: physical terminal character entry
observations.detail: After Terminal mounts with a NodesRef focus request, real OS typing enters echo T3RETURNMARKER in the command field without a pointer focus step.

observations.name: physical Return submission
observations.detail: A real Return key leaves echo T3RETURNMARKER in the command field and the PTY history contains no marker output; bindconfirm is not delivered by the current Native runtime.

classification.closedProductLoss: The Native Terminal command field now owns focus when the surface opens and accepts real character input.
remainingProductLoss: Physical Return does not deliver bindconfirm, so the visible Run control remains the only verified command submission path.
Full xterm key-by-key input, selection, and split terminals remain outside this slice.
classification.harnessLoss: Several pointer attempts used incorrect shadow-scaled coordinates and were excluded; the retained character-entry pass requires no pointer focus.
classification.intentionalPlatformDelta: Native uses a bounded command field and Run action rather than Web xterm.
